hook_text: Playing hide and seek with my notifications

song.title: Can't Find Me
song.style: English, playful surf rock with twangy guitar, bouncy bass, tambourine, cheeky male vocal with whoa-oh backing vocals, 128 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Pings are counting up to ten
Looking for me once again
But my phone is wrapped in orange
And I'm long gone round the bend

[Chorus]
Can't find me, can't find me
I'm up climbing in a tree
Can't find me, can't find me
Hide and seek and I am free

shots.prompt: A small figure tiptoes away from a little house and dives into a big round bush, only his feet sticking out and wiggling. Static medium shot. Bright sunny light, saturated greens.
A boy climbs a chunky tree and settles on a branch, peeking out through the leaves with a grin. The camera tilts up with him. Dappled sunlight.

A hand gently slides a black smartphone all the way down into a slim terracotta-orange sleeve standing upright on a soft cream studio backdrop, until the phone disappears inside and only the rounded thumb notch at the top remains. A small closed-eye emblem is pressed into the front of the sleeve. The hand pulls away and the sleeve stands still, casting a soft shadow. Static close-up, the light slowly turns warmer.
A girl paddles a small rowboat across a calm pond toward a little island, ducks following behind. Wide static shot. Bright midday light, blue water.
Two friends hide behind a giant sunflower, giggling, as a dog sniffs past. Static medium shot. Warm sunlight.
A figure lies in a hammock between two trees reading a book, swaying gently. The camera slowly pushes in. Soft afternoon light.
A family has a picnic on a checkered blanket on a hill, passing sandwiches around. Overhead shot, slowly rotating. Bright sunny colours.
A kid rolls down a grassy hill, tumbling over and over, then lies laughing at the bottom. Side tracking shot. Golden light.
A figure sits on top of a tree house watching stars appear over a little village with glowing windows. The camera slowly pulls back. Deep blue dusk and warm window glow.

caption: My Eyelid is the best hiding spot. The pings have been counting to ten since Tuesday.
